name: African Alliance Insurance Plc
source: African Alliance Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, as reported in New Telegraph (9 October 2026) and Punch (both reading the audited accounts and the company's NGX filings). Insurance revenue NGN 911.83m, insurance service expenses NGN 35.09bn, insurance service result NGN -34.18bn, net insurance and investment result NGN 7.10bn, other expenses NGN 1.58bn, profit before tax NGN 5.52bn, income tax NGN 1.66bn, profit after tax NGN 3.87bn; figures printed to two decimal places of a billion NGN and stored here in absolute NGN. | CRON 20261106: African Alliance Insurance Plc result at a glance and statement of comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025, printed pages 1 and 3, https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48053_AFRICAN_ALLIANCE_INSURANCE_PLC-_YEAR_END_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2025_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf . Printed N thousand: insurance revenue 911,830 (2024: 10,252,050); profit before tax 5,523,546 (2024: 3,178,026); income tax 1,657,063 (2024: 6,117); profit for the year 3,866,483 (2024: 3,171,909). The stored income tax row was misaligned by one column from the second period onward: it read 1,660,000,000 for FY2024 against the printed 6,117,000, and carried the FY2024 figure 6,118,000 under FY2023. FY2023 tax is proved from the file's own PBT and profit, -4,552,695,000 less -322,000 equals -4,552,373,000, so -322,000 belongs to FY2023. The row is now [1,657,063,000, 6,117,000, -322,000] and every period ties: 5,523,546 less 1,657,063 equals 3,866,483; 3,178,026 less 6,117 equals 3,171,909. PBT and profit for FY2025 and FY2024 are replaced with the printed thousands scaled to naira, replacing rounded cells. EPS is not printed anywhere in this filing, so the EPS row stays empty rather than being derived from a share count.
note: Both years are the issuer printed columns in its FY2024 audited statements. Insurance revenue maps to Revenue, Insurance service expenses to Cost of Sales, Insurance service results to Gross Profit, Management expenses to Operating Expenses and Net insurance finance income to Net Finance Costs, per the panel nearest label rule. Income Tax is the difference between printed Profit before taxation and printed Profit for the year and is derived, not printed. EPS is left out because the issuer's per share lines extract blank. Operating Profit (EBIT) is left blank because it cannot be reconciled to the printed Profit before taxation. Previous stored series (FY2019 to FY2015) was withdrawn on this date: its Revenue row repeated the same two values across four of its five periods and no filing could confirm the period labels; the withdrawn copy is kept at static_data/_bak_AFRINSURE_income_20261010_1353.json.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.formula: Insurance Service Result less Other Expenses less Profit Before Tax (net investment income is carried here because the panel schema has no investment income line)

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.derivedFormula: Income Tax = Profit Before Tax - Net Profit
rows.derivedNote: Difference of the two printed lines, exact in both years.
rows.formula: printed profit before tax less printed profit after tax (the press rounded tax to NGN 1.66bn)

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedFrom: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
